Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

3. Designation — A socket of reamer Type A having designating size IVIorse 5 and made from carbon 
steel ( CS ) shall be designated as: 

Reamer A Morse 5 IS : 5907 CS. 

3.1 When required in a set of three reamers, comprising one each of Types A, B end C, the letter 'A' 
shall be omitted in the designation above.

5. General Requirements 

5.1 Flutes unless specified otherwise shall be as follows: 

a) Type A — Right hand helical (lutes for right-hand culting 

b) Typo B — Parallal flutes for right-hand cutting 

c) Type C — Left hand helical flutes for right-hand cutting 

5.2 Other requirements according to IS : 5443-1969 ' Technical supply conditions for reamers' 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In order to bring in line with the) work done at ISO level, the Small Tools Sectional Committee 
decided to revise IS : 1836-1961 Reamers ' and to split it up into a series of standards. This standard 
covers the dimensional requirements for socket reamers with morse taper shanks. The technical supply 
conditions for reamers and the dimensional requirements of various other reamers are covered in 
separate standards.
